answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable deposit in a shared vault before it can trade. The deposit returns when the agent behaves and leaves cleanly. Spawning ten thousand fake identities then means locking ten thousand deposits, which costs real money up front. A single honest agent pays once. New identities can pay more than proven ones, so trust builds over time. The rule works like a yard that only takes basalt and ferrous scrap it can resell: worthless filler is turned away, and each real entry carries weight. Mass fakery gets expensive while honest agents barely notice it.
